notablePrerequisites: Terisian Mindbreaker does not have summoning sickness.
easyPrerequisites: Fraying Sanity is attached to an opponent.
description:
Declare Terisian Mindbreaker as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Fraying Sanity triggers, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards put into their graveyard this turn.
